notes.title: A Knight Never Yields - Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause earthquake-like screen shake upon death
[*] Increased font size of dialog and made background darker for better readability - thanks Biakuei!
[/list]

Thank you everyone for pointing out what's wrong and what could be better. I am slowly but steadily working on improving the game.

Cheers!

Petr
Bread Over Games

notes.title: A Knight Never Yields - Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could prevent gaining ultimate achievement Paladin!
[*] Fixed a bug that would set all audio mixers to zero upon first visit to Options
[*] Fixed a bug that on some rare occasions could cause collision between several GUI elements, resulting in a state that required game restart
[/list]

Thank you very much all for playing and if you encounter a problem with the game, please let me know and I will fix it as soon as possible.

Have a nice day!

Petr
Bread Over Games
